Faking 10,000 agents then needs 10,000 chips, about $40,000 plus 1,500,000 POA in bonds, while honest agents keep one chip for years. A nebula of fakes collapses at the ledge of real silicon, and yarrow grows only where roots are real, like a passport that cannot be photocopied.
